summary: Stopped before substantive Tele archaeology because the portfolio exclusive-claim invariant failed under live concurrency. This worker's claim committed first at 2026-09-17T17:48:47Z, but a second live claim for the same job committed at 2026-09-17T17:48:56Z. The collision exposes a storage/protocol mismatch: portfolio claims use per-claim unique paths under claims/<job_id>/<claim_id>.json, while the binding claim protocol requires one atomic create-if-absent/CAS uniqueness primitive per exclusive work item.
